claims.exact_statement: For every multiplexer F(x,y)=g_x(y) with a selector bits, Delta:=H(F)-2^{-a} sum_b H(g_b) satisfies Delta=M_W+B_W with 0<=M_W<=min(a,(2/ln2) I_sel(F)) and 0<=B_W<=a*h2(I_sel(F)/a) (h2(0)=0; for a=0 both sides vanish). Hence Delta<=min(a,(2/ln2) I_sel)+a*h2(I_sel/a)<=I_sel*log2(e^3 a/I_sel). Here M_W=a-sum_T R_T H(r_T), B_W=sum_T R_T H(nu_T)=H(S_sel|S_data) as in threshold paper Prop. 8.6 eq. (75).
hypotheses: F(x,y)=g_x(y) with x a fresh uniform selector block of a>=0 bits independent of uniform data y in {0,1}^m
g_b arbitrary Boolean (+-1) functions on the common data cube; no balance, orthogonality or disjointness
entropy H(f)=sum_S fhat(S)^2 log2(1/fhat(S)^2); influence = physical edge disagreement probability; h2 binary entropy in bits

claims.exact_statement: For even m>=2 let g_0(y)=(-1)^{y1y2+...+y_{m-1}y_m} and g_1=g_0 with the value at y=0 flipped; F(x,y)=g_x(y) (a=1). With u=2^{-m/2}: I_sel=2^{-m}=u^2 exactly and Delta=m u^2+A+B where A=-2 sum_{e=+-1} w_e (1-e u)^2 log2(1-e u), B=sum_e w_e (1-2eu)^2 log2|1-2eu|, w_e=(1+eu)/2. Consequently Delta=I_sel(m+3/ln2)-(19/(6 ln2)) I_sel^2+O(I_sel^3) and [(2/ln2)I_sel+h2(I_sel)]-Delta=(8/(3 ln2)) I_sel^2+O(I_sel^3)>0. For the t-fold tensor power (a=t selector bits, tm data bits) Delta, I_sel and the B04-SEL-LOG-SHARP bound are t times the one-bit values. Hence for every eps>0 no function psi with psi(s,a)<=(2/ln2)s+a h2(s/a)-eps s bounds Delta over all multiplexers.
